tours.name: Create a New Employee
tours.description: Learn how to create an employee record: enter the name and job details, choose the department and manager, add work contact information, review the other tabs, and save.

description_i18n.en_US: Learn how to create an employee record: enter the name and job details, choose the department and manager, add work contact information, review the other tabs, and save.

steps.title: Open Employees
steps.description: The Employees app holds one record for every person who works for the company. It is where HR keeps contact details, job information and settings.

description_i18n.en_US: The Employees app holds one record for every person who works for the company. It is where HR keeps contact details, job information and settings.

steps.title: New employee
steps.content: Click New to create an employee.

content_i18n.en_US: Click New to create an employee.

steps.description: The New button opens a blank employee form. Nothing is stored until you save it.

description_i18n.en_US: The New button opens a blank employee form. Nothing is stored until you save it.

steps.title: Employee name
steps.content: Type the employee's full name, then press Tab.

content_i18n.en_US: Type the employee's full name, then press Tab.

steps.description: The name identifies the employee everywhere in Odoo, for example on leave requests, payslips and attendance records. Use the full legal name.

description_i18n.en_US: The name identifies the employee everywhere in Odoo, for example on leave requests, payslips and attendance records. Use the full legal name.

steps.title: Job title
steps.content: Type the job title, then press Tab.

content_i18n.en_US: Type the job title, then press Tab.

steps.description: The job title is shown under the name on the employee card and in the company directory. It is free text, so it can describe the role in your own words.

description_i18n.en_US: The job title is shown under the name on the employee card and in the company directory. It is free text, so it can describe the role in your own words.

steps.title: Search Department
steps.content: Click the field and type the first letters of what you are looking for.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the field and type the first letters of what you are looking for.

steps.description: The department places the employee in your organisation chart and decides which team reports and approvals they belong to. Typing narrows the list down; you pick the result in the next step.

description_i18n.en_US: The department places the employee in your organisation chart and decides which team reports and approvals they belong to. Typing narrows the list down; you pick the result in the next step.

steps.validation_message: Type at least two letters of what you are looking for.

validation_message_i18n.en_US: Type at least two letters of what you are looking for.

steps.title: Choose the department
steps.content: Click the result you want in the list.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the result you want in the list.

steps.description: Pick the department the employee works in. If you cannot find it, start typing its name to narrow down the list.

description_i18n.en_US: Pick the department the employee works in. If you cannot find it, start typing its name to narrow down the list.

steps.title: Check the manager
steps.content: Check the manager. Click the field to continue.

content_i18n.en_US: Check the manager. Click the field to continue.

steps.description: Odoo fills in the manager from the department you chose, so it is usually already correct. If the field is empty or the manager is wrong, pick the right person from the list that opens, then continue. Click the field to continue.

description_i18n.en_US: Odoo fills in the manager from the department you chose, so it is usually already correct. If the field is empty or the manager is wrong, pick the right person from the list that opens, then continue. Click the field to continue.

steps.title: Work Information tab
steps.description: This tab holds the contact details and settings that apply while the person is at work, such as work email, phone and working schedule.

description_i18n.en_US: This tab holds the contact details and settings that apply while the person is at work, such as work email, phone and working schedule.

steps.title: Work email
steps.content: Type the work email address, then press Tab.

content_i18n.en_US: Type the work email address, then press Tab.

steps.description: Odoo uses the work email to contact the employee, for example to send payslips and notifications. Make sure it is typed correctly.

description_i18n.en_US: Odoo uses the work email to contact the employee, for example to send payslips and notifications. Make sure it is typed correctly.

steps.title: Private Information tab
steps.description: This tab stores personal details such as home address, emergency contact and bank account. Only HR users can see it.

description_i18n.en_US: This tab stores personal details such as home address, emergency contact and bank account. Only HR users can see it.

steps.title: HR Settings tab
steps.description: HR Settings holds the technical settings of the record, such as the linked user account, the employee number and attendance options.

description_i18n.en_US: HR Settings holds the technical settings of the record, such as the linked user account, the employee number and attendance options.

steps.title: Save
steps.content: Click the save icon to keep the employee.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the save icon to keep the employee.

steps.description: The cloud icon saves the record. Until you save, the employee does not exist and the changes would be lost if you leave the page.

description_i18n.en_US: The cloud icon saves the record. Until you save, the employee does not exist and the changes would be lost if you leave the page.

steps.title: Saved employee
steps.content: The employee is saved and shown in the breadcrumb. Click it to finish.

content_i18n.en_US: The employee is saved and shown in the breadcrumb. Click it to finish.

steps.description: Once saved, the employee's name appears at the top of the page and the record is ready to receive a contract, time off and other information.

description_i18n.en_US: Once saved, the employee's name appears at the top of the page and the record is ready to receive a contract, time off and other information.
